exercises.audioText: While a brief afternoon nap boosts alertness, it cannot fully replace uninterrupted deep sleep for long-term memory consolidation.

options.text: Naps are as effective as eight hours of night sleep.

title: US airspace reopens after flights grounded for several hours
subtitle: On Friday, the US made the rare decision to ground flights nationwide, leaving tens of t…

exercises.prompt: What caused the nationwide grounding of flights in the US?
exercises.audioText: On Friday, the US made the rare decision to ground flights nationwide, leaving tens of thousands of people stranded. An overloaded air traffic control system triggered communications failures across the country.

options.text: A confirmed cyberattack on aviation systems
An overloaded air traffic control system
Severe winter weather across the country
A strike by air traffic controllers

exercises.tip: 听力中明确提到 'An overloaded air traffic control system triggered communications failures'，说明原因是空管系统超负荷。白宫表示没有网络攻击的证据，因此 A 是干扰项；C、D 均未在内容中出现。
exercises.zhText: 周五，美国罕见地决定在全国范围内停飞航班，导致数以万计的旅客滞留。超负荷运转的空中交通管制系统引发了全国范围的通信故障。

exercises.prompt: 听写节目核心表达
exercises.audioText: Flights resumed after four hours, but getting the aviation network back to normal will take time.
exercises.template: Flights ____ after four hours, but getting the aviation network back to normal will take time.
exercises.tip: resumed 意为“恢复、重新开始”，与后文 'back to normal'（恢复正常）语义呼应。听写时注意词尾 -sumed 的弱读与连读，不要误写成 assume 或 consumed。
exercises.zhText: 航班在四小时后恢复起降，但要让整个航空网络恢复正常仍需要时间。

exercises.zhText: 一场全球性的微软系统故障波及学校、医院和企业。微软表示尚未发现恶意攻击导致此次故障的证据。

subtitle: A lot of today’s war footage is shot on phones and posted to platforms that were never m…

exercises.prompt: What is the main purpose of Hadi Al Khatib's project Mnemonic?
exercises.audioText: Hadi Al Khatib founded Mnemonic to save war photos and videos before they vanish and turn social media posts into evidence that holds up in court.

options.text: To preserve war footage and use it as legal evidence
To create social media platforms for sharing war videos
To entertain people with phone footage from war zones
To remove all disturbing war content from the internet

exercises.tip: 主旨题：Mnemonic 的核心目标是保存战争影像，并将其转化为可在法庭上使用的证据。
exercises.zhText: 哈迪·阿尔·哈提卜创立了 Mnemonic，用于在战争照片和视频消失前将其保存下来，并将社交媒体帖文转化为经得起法庭检验的证据。

exercises.prompt: 听写节目核心表达
exercises.audioText: His team turns people’s social media posts into evidence of crimes that holds up in court.
exercises.template: His team turns people’s social media posts into ____ of crimes that holds up in court.
exercises.tip: 关键词是 evidence，表示“证据”；注意 turn...into... 表示“把……转化为……”。
exercises.zhText: 他的团队将人们发布的社交媒体内容转化为在法庭上具有效力的犯罪证据。

title: Could this ancient Greek idea make us better citizens? | Scott Reich
subtitle: More than 2,000 years ago in ancient Athens, young citizens were required to complete “e…

exercises.prompt: What is the main idea of the talk?
exercises.audioText: More than 2,000 years ago in ancient Athens, young citizens completed “ephebeia,” a two-year civic service program. Scott Reich believes this practice reminds us that citizens aren’t born—they’re trained.

options.text: Civic virtue is inherited at birth.
Ancient Athens trained young citizens through a two-year civic service program.
Scott Reich wants to replace all US schools with ancient Greek classes.
Ephebeia taught young citizens how to avoid defending their democracy.

exercises.tip: 音频提到 ephebeia 是两年公民服务项目，训练青年了解法律和保卫民主；Reich 强调公民需要培养，而非天生。
exercises.zhText: 两千多年前的古雅典，年轻公民需要完成名为“ephebeia”的为期两年的公民服务项目。斯科特·赖希认为，这一做法提醒我们：公民并非天生，而是培养出来的。

exercises.prompt: 听写节目核心表达
exercises.audioText: Author and historian Scott Reich believes this practice reflects something crucial we often forget: citizens aren’t born — they’re trained.
exercises.template: Author and historian Scott Reich believes this practice reflects something crucial we often forget: citizens aren’t ____ — they’re trained.
exercises.tip: 核心表达是 citizens aren’t born—they’re trained（公民不是天生的，而是训练出来的），空格处听写 born。
exercises.zhText: 作家兼历史学家斯科特·赖希认为，这一传统折射出我们常忽略的关键一点：公民不是天生的，而是后天训练造就的。

title: How we’ll actually ditch fossil fuels — by the numbers | Michael Liebreich
subtitle: Have you heard the clean energy transition is failing? Energy analyst Michael Liebreich …

exercises.prompt: What is Michael Liebreich's main point about the clean energy transition?
exercises.audioText: Energy analyst Michael Liebreich says to look again. Using a four-line spreadsheet model of the global energy system, he shows why fossil fuels will inevitably get squeezed out over time, with no bans required.

options.text: The clean energy transition is failing.
Fossil fuels will inevitably be squeezed out over time without bans.
Governments must ban fossil fuels immediately.
The shift looks exactly as many people expected.

exercises.tip: 主旨细节题：听力中明确说化石燃料会逐渐被挤出，而且不需要禁令，因此选 B。
exercises.zhText: 能源分析师迈克尔·利布赖希认为应该换个角度看问题。他用一个简单的四行全球能源系统电子表格模型说明，即便没有禁令，化石燃料假以时日也必然会被逐步挤出市场。

exercises.prompt: 听写节目核心表达
exercises.audioText: The shift is well underway, he explains: it just looks different than many of us expected.
exercises.template: The shift is well underway, he explains: it just looks ____ than many of us expected.
exercises.tip: 关键词听写：核心表达是 looks different than many of us expected，注意 different 的拼写。
exercises.zhText: 他解释说，这场转型其实已经全面展开，只是它的呈现方式和许多人预想的不太一样。

title: How to repair harm — in relationships and nations | Aria Florant
subtitle: Aria Florant cofounded a nonprofit to help accelerate the reparations movement in the US…

exercises.prompt: What does Aria Florant say about true repair?
exercises.audioText: Most people think reparations are all about money, but true repair goes far beyond the financial.

options.text: It is mainly about money.
It goes far beyond money.
It only works between nations.
It requires no process.

exercises.tip: 主旨细节题：讲话者强调真正的修复远不止金钱层面。
exercises.zhText: 大多数人以为赔偿只关乎金钱，但真正的修复远不止于经济层面。

exercises.prompt: 听写节目核心表达
exercises.audioText: Aria Florant lays out a four-step process for repairing harm.
exercises.template: Aria Florant lays out a ____ process for repairing harm.
exercises.tip: 关键词听写：注意 four-step 表示“四步的”，修饰 process。
exercises.zhText: 阿里娅·弗洛兰特梳理出了一套修复伤害的四步流程。

title: Your phone is disgusting. Here's how to clean it | Lotti Tajouri
subtitle: What’s dirtier: your phone or your hands? Molecular biologist Lotti Tajouri says there’s…

exercises.prompt: What is the speaker's main point about phones and hygiene?
exercises.audioText: What’s dirtier: your phone or your hands? Molecular biologist Lotti Tajouri says there’s a gaping hole in our hygiene routine.

options.text: Phones are cleaner than hands if wiped daily.
Phones are a neglected part of hygiene and can harbor microbes.
Handwashing is unnecessary because phones are the problem.
Bacteria cannot survive on warm, humid phones.

exercises.tip: 主旨是手机常被忽视，却是细菌和病毒的温床，因此应纳入日常清洁习惯。
exercises.zhText: 你的手机和你的手，哪个更脏？分子生物学家洛蒂·塔朱里指出，我们的日常卫生习惯存在一个巨大的漏洞。

exercises.prompt: 听写节目核心表达
exercises.audioText: We scrub our hands clean, then reach right for the phone — a warm, humid and mobile home for bacteria and viruses.
exercises.template: We scrub our hands clean, then reach right for the phone — a warm, ____ and mobile home for bacteria and viruses.
exercises.tip: humid 表示“潮湿的”，与 warm、mobile 一起描述手机为微生物提供适宜环境。
exercises.zhText: 我们把手搓洗干净后，紧接着就去拿手机——而手机恰恰是温暖、潮湿又随身携带的细菌和病毒温床。
